import os,re,json

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Print all occurrences of the output tile's transforms per demo (positions), plus block position, to infer offset rule precisely.
for p in [1,2,3]:
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); dh,dw=len(go),len(go[0])
    rs=[r for r in range(H) if 8 in gi[r]]; rb=min(rs); cb=min([c for c in range(W) if gi[rb][c]==8])
    frs=[(r,c) for r in range(H-dh+1) for c in range(W-dw+1)
         if [[gi[r+i][c+j] for j in range(dw)] for i in range(dh)]==[row[::-1] for row in go]]
    ros=[(r,c) for r in range(H-dh+1) for c in range(W-dw+1)
         if [[gi[r+i][c+j] for j in range(dw)] for i in range(dh)]==[row[::-1] for row in go[::-1]]]
    fis=[(r,c) for r in range(H-dh+1) for c in range(W-dw+1)
         if [[gi[r+i][c+j] for j in range(dw)] for i in range(dh)]==go[::-1]]
    fid=[(r,c) for r in range(H-dh+1) for c in range(W-dw+1) if [[gi[r+i][c+j] for j in range(dw)] for i in range(dh)]==go]
    print(f'pair{p}: block({rb},{cb}); fr={frs}; ro180={ros}; fud={fis}; id={fid}')
